jobs.description:
Responsible for the 
quality management within the plant, the Quality & CI Manager will be in charge of the following missions:
 

 
 

· determines, implements and adjusts quality standards and policies,
 

· initiates and implements systems of quality control, mainly of : the raw materials and the products manufactured by the plant
 

· makes the appropriated proposals to improve products or processes
 

· prepares all the internal and external quality audits and manages the follow-up 
 

· responsible for all other operational aspects related to quality: taking of samples, training and coaching people, ...
 

· maintains ISO9001 and other certifications of quality
 

· creates and maintains articles in SAP
 

· regular international contacts with other quality responsibles 
 

· involved in the different projects led in the Group
 

· manages a team of laboratory workers
 

· attends to the management meeting, quality meeting, etc.
 

· making sure that 5S process is well implemented and respected and organizes audit in accordance with the planning
 

· Takes care that all laboratory equipment is present, enough for the needed analyzes and in good status
 

 
 

Responsible for the 
CI within the plant, the Quality & CI Manager will be in charge of the following missions:
 

· To continuously improve plant performance in line with business strategy requirements and reducing overall maintenance lifecycle cost.
 

· Ensuring plant always produces product to customer specifications.
 

· Setting internal operational standards and measurement of process capability through KPIs.
 

· Reporting of operational performance and adherence to both internal and customer specifications.
 

· Undertake root cause analysis of any out of specification result and recommend effective corrective & preventive actions to avoid reoccurrence in line with the applicable CI techniques.
 

 
 

· 
Optimisation of plant performance – quality, safety, cycle times, costs etc….

· Ensure Operational readiness for internal & external audits and technical reviews.

· Lead plant teams implementation of Continuous Improvement within the Operational function to deliver the 3 year Business Plan strategy.

 

• You have a Bachelor or Master degree 

• You have relevant experience in Quality and/or Continuous improvement 

• You have managerial skills 

• You’re result oriented 

• You are fluent in Dutch and English 

• You have a flexible and no nonsense personality

As a Customer Support Assistant, you will be responsible for delivering a smooth and professional customer experience from the first contact through to order delivery.
 
 

• Be the first point of contact for distributors and end users, handling questions, requests and issues in a professional and customer-oriented way. 

• Manage the complete order process, from order intake through logistics, including coordinating shipments and transport. 

• Provide high-quality customer support via phone, email and chat. 

• Follow up on customer requests and issues and ensure timely and effective resolution. 

• Keep customer information, interactions and issues accurately recorded in our CRM system. 

• Identify recurring customer issues and share insights with internal teams to help improve our products and services. 

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve our customer service processes and contribute to initiatives that make our way of working more efficient. 

• Work closely with colleagues across different teams to ensure a seamless customer experience. 

You are a customer-oriented and solution-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and working in a fast-paced environment.
 

You bring:
 
 

• Fluency in English and French, both written and spoken - this is essential. 

• A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required. 

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. 

• A structured and accurate way of working, with a strong eye for detail. 

• The ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of service. 

• A proactive, positive and customer-centric mindset. 

• Previous experience in customer support, order administration or a similar role is a plus. 

• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Field Sales Manager - Belgium and the Netherlands M/W/X
jobs.description:
About the Role
You will lead business development from A to Z, working directly with Ekwip's three co-founders.

Independent and specialised retailers

• Identify and target retailers in sports, fashion, footwear, pet care, home, toys and books
• Build your own pipeline through cold calling, store visits, networking and trade fairs
• Manage qualification, negotiation and closing
• Organise your prospecting by region with a strong focus on efficiency and results
Distributors and industrial wholesalers

• Identify the most relevant partners
• Define the right approach and activate new opportunities
• Lead negotiations and close strategic agreements
• Develop partnerships where one agreement can unlock an entire network of stores
Market insights and performance

• Act as Ekwip's eyes and ears in the market
• Share customer needs, recurring objections and local market practices
• Feed insights directly into the product roadmap
• Continuously manage your pipeline and performanceGrowth opportunities
Ekwip's medium-term ambition is to build a commercial team in each country, with Business Developers and Account Managers.

You will be the first building block of this structure. Strong performance can lead to a management role, where you will recruit, train and lead your own local sales team.
 Your Profile
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Sales or a related field
• Fluent Dutch is essential, as this is the main market to develop; French and English are needed
• A successful first experience in B2B sales, with proven results
• Valid driving licence
What we are looking for

• A true hunter mindset: you are comfortable with cold outreach and know how to build a pipeline from scratch
• Strong autonomy: you manage your territory like your own business
• Genuine curiosity for retail: you listen as much as you sell
• A structured and methodical approach to pipeline management
• The motivation to build in a fast-paced, demanding and pragmatic environment
• Experience in retail, SaaS or marketplaces is a strong advantage What We Offer
• Permanent contract
• Competitive base salary, depending on experience
• Attractive performance-based bonus
• Company car
• Potential access to a Stock Option Plan, depending on profile and performance
• Real autonomy and the opportunity to quickly progress towards a Head of Sales roleHow to Apply
• Send your CV and a few lines about the deal you are most proud of
• No cover letter required
Ekwip is committed to equal opportunities. This position is open to all qualified candidates.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are responsible for both the design and implementation of logistics solutions for new and existing customers.

 
• Analyze customer requirements, operational data and logistics flows
 
• Design efficient warehouse processes, layouts and automation concepts
 
• Develop pricing models, cost calculations and business cases

jobs.occupation: AI Implementation Intern with specific focus on AI adoption in European HR M/W/X
jobs.description:
This internship offers a unique opportunity to explore how Artificial Intelligence can enhance HR, Recruitment, Learning & Development, and other people-related functions by identifying opportunities for process optimisation, automation, and improved employee experience.

 

• Analyse business processes across People & Culture, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, and related people functions to identify opportunities for AI adoption and process optimisation.
• Research AI tools, technologies and emerging solutions applicable to people-related business processes.
• Evaluate existing workflows and identify opportunities for automation, improved efficiency and enhanced employee experience.
• Benchmark industry best practices and AI use cases across HR and People functions.
• Develop recommendations for AI implementation, including suitable technologies, expected business impact and implementation considerations.
• Assess organisational readiness, transformation anticipated risks, required capabilities and change management considerations for AI adoption.
• Collaborate with HR, People and Culture Director and business stakeholders to validate opportunities and prioritise initiatives.
• Present findings, business cases and implementation roadmaps to project stakeholders. 
• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, AI, Computer Science, Data Science, ICT Management, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Strong interest in the practical application of Artificial Intelligence within business functions, particularly HR, Recruitment, and People Operations.
• Good understanding of current AI technologies, including generative AI, automation, workflow optimisation, or intelligent process improvement.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to map business processes and identify opportunities for increased efficiency.
• Excellent research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate findings into practical recommendations.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Knowledge of German, French and/or Dutch is considered a strong advantage.
• Previous exposure to AI tools (e.g. Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Microsoft Power Platform, automation platforms, or similar technologies) is an asset.
• Candidates with a combination of HR knowledge and AI/technology expertise are particularly encouraged to apply.

This large Belgian organization manages a technically complex and business-critical network where operational safety, real-time communication and system reliability are essential. Behind the scenes, several digital platforms support field operations, control rooms and operational staff in managing safety-critical processes.
Within this context, one of the core applications is evolving from a single solution into a broader ecosystem of applications focused on the safety of real-time operations. To support this evolution, the organization is looking for an experienced Architect who can bring structure, technical vision and architectural leadership to the team.

Jobomschrijving

You will define and guide the technical architecture of a growing application ecosystem used in safety-critical operational processes. You will work closely with developers, analysts, product stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that new and existing solutions are scalable, reliable and future-proof.
You will use your expertise to assess current implementations, propose improvements and help shape upcoming developments. You will coach developers, promote best practices and ensure that architectural decisions are translated into clean, maintainable and robust solutions.
You will also proactively identify technical risks, challenge implementation choices where needed and ensure that quality, scope and deadlines remain aligned. Because the applications support real-time operational workflows, performance, stability and clear communication are crucial throughout your mission.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• Experience as Architect / Senior Analyst
• Knowledge of Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

As Chief Project Officer, you will lead our complete project portfolio in the Benelux and across Europe. You will manage three direct reports and take responsibility for a multidisciplinary project organisation of approximately 15 employees across BIM, work preparation, project management, site management, automation and part of the validation activities. You will create the structure, standards and leadership needed to support continued growth.

You will get to know our customers, markets and ADAPTUS platform (our modular platform for standardised, scalable cleanroom solutions) inside out.

Your responsibilities include:

•Taking final responsibility for projects from design and execution through to delivery

•Leading, coaching and developing three direct reports and the wider multidisciplinary project organisation of approximately 15 employees

•Acting as a technical sparring partner on complex HVAC and cleanroom challenges

•Safeguarding margins, planning, quality and performance across the project portfolio

•Building and managing reliable subcontractor networks throughout Europe

•Driving standardisation and process optimisation through the ADAPTUS platform

•Translating our European ambitions into a scalable project organisation
 

Once you have demonstrated clear leadership, organisational impact and operational excellence, your responsibilities will expand to Chief Operating Officer.

As COO, you will take responsibility for a broader operational organisation of approximately 22 employees on the ABN payroll, complemented by an extensive network of subcontractors responsible for project execution. Your scope will include projects and service, including maintenance, validation and operational customer support. You will develop service into a profitable activity within our Cleanroom-as-a-Service strategy and connect projects and service into one seamless customer lifecycle.

The transition to Chief Operating Officer is based on demonstrated leadership, organisational impact and operational excellence. For the right candidate, this progression is expected within approximately six to eighteen months.

You combine strong leadership skills with genuine technical depth.

HVAC holds no secrets for you. You understand air handling, pressure cascades, cooling loads and control technology well enough to challenge BIM specialists, work preparation teams, project managers, site managers, automation experts, validation specialists and subcontractors on content.

You also bring:

•At least ten years of experience in complex technical projects at customer sites

•Several years of experience in a senior leadership role

•Experience managing managers and multidisciplinary technical teams, rather than only operational teams

•Proven greenfield experience in another European country

•Hands-on experience sourcing, contracting and managing local subcontractors abroad

•A technical master’s degree or equivalent experience

•Fluency in Dutch and English; French or German is an advantage

•A structural willingness to travel across Europe

•An entrepreneurial, hands-on and highly result-driven mindset
 

Experience in cleanrooms, pharmaceuticals, biotech, laboratories, food production or high-tech environments is a strong asset.

Above all, you are a builder. You do not wait for the perfect structure — you create it.

Scope
 

The main role of the CAD (Cadence) support engineer is to provide CAD support for all design and layout engineers and to ensure continuous improvement of the ICsense design environment for higher efficiency and user friendliness. You work closely together with other CAD Support Engineers. 
 

Responsibilities
 

· Develop custom tools (from automation scripts to GUI’s) for the ICsense design environment in Python, SKILL and Matlab
 

· Act as CAD Support Engineer: 
 

 maintenance and configuration of the CAD tools (Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens, Matlab, Perforce, ...)
 

 maintenance, development and configuration of the proprietary ICsense design environment
 

 maintenance and installation of the IC technologies and PDKs at ICsense
 

 give CAD support for the designers and layouters at ICsense
 

· Work closely together with other CAD Support Engineers
 

· CAD user group: participate in the regular meetings and ensure follow up of the discussed items
 

· Support internal CAD training initiatives
 

· Write documentation, manuals and keep the CAD information on Confluence up to date

Competences
 
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master degree in Electronics or Informatics 

• You have experience with programming languages like Python, scripting 

• You have experience working in a Linux environment  

• You have an affinity for ASIC design/layout or PCB concepts  

• Experience with CAD tools from Cadence/Synopsys/Siemens/Matlab is a plus 

• You communicate fluently in English (oral and written) 

• You are well-organized and able to work independently while solving problems effectively

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer | Create real business impact
jobs.description:
Work at the intersection oftechnology, data, and business, identifying opportunities where AI can create value and turning business needs into solutions.

Ready for a new challenge in AI?Join an international technology company in Brussels and contribute to the development of AI solutions that create real business impact.

 

Our partner, aninternational professional company, is looking for anAI Engineerto join its team and contribute to the design, development, and deployment of AI-powered solutions.
AI Engineer - What's the job about
• Design, develop, and deployAI-powered solutionsaddressing real-world business challenges.
• Develop and integrate solutions based onMachine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
• Integrate AI models and services into existing applications, systems, and IT environments.
• Collaborate with IT, data, and business teams to identifyAI and automation opportunitiesacross the organization.
• Develop prototypes and POCs, and transform successful concepts intorobust, scalable, production-ready solutions.
• Work on data pipelines, model evaluation, and the continuous improvement of AI solution performance.
• Contribute to the documentation of AI solutions and the development ofAI and MLOps best practices.
AI Engineer - Who we are looking for
• 2 to 5 years of experience inAI Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, or AI solution development.
• Strong proficiency inPythonand hands-on experience developing AI-powered solutions.
• Solid understanding ofMachine Learning, Generative AI, and LLMs.
• Experience with AI frameworks and tools such asPyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or LangChain.
• Good understanding ofAPIs, cloud architectures, and deployment environments.
• Experience withAWS, Azure, or GCPand/or MLOps technologies is a strong plus.
• Analytical and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
• Curious, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-changing technological environment.
• Fluent in English and Dutch.

For a international client in Data information with it's headquarters in Antwerp are we looking for a Team Lead.

We are seeking an experienced Team Lead Java to join the team and drive the development of cutting-edge software solutions that support logistics, supply chain, and identification services. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to a company at the forefront of technology, delivering impactful solutions for clients worldwide.
Role
In this role, you will lead a team of skilled Java developers, overseeing architecture design, ensuring code quality, and guiding team members to achieve their full potential. You’ll be responsible for managing the end-to-end development cycle, collaborating closely with other departments to deliver high-quality applications. This position is ideal for someone with strong Java expertise, leadership experience, and a passion for innovation.

Profile
The ideal candidate is a seasoned Java developer with proven experience in leading technical teams.

You possess:

• 8+ years of experience in Java development, with a strong understanding of frameworks like Spring Boot.
• Leadership skills, demonstrated through previous team lead or supervisory roles in software development.
• A passion for mentoring and growing team members’ skills, with a focus on collaboration and continuous improvement.
• Solid experience with architecture design and ensuring high standards in code quality.
• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to work effectively across departments.
• Experience in agile methodologies and a commitment to staying updated with industry best practices.

We're looking for an IT Project Engineer to play a key role in a fast-evolving Benelux environment. You'll combine hands-on IT expertise with project leadership, supporting critical business systems while driving strategic initiatives across ERP, e-commerce, cloud, and business applications.

• Drive local and international IT projects, including ERP and digital platform transformations.
• Support and optimize business-critical applications such as ERP, e-commerce, CRM, and customer support tools.
• Act as the go-to expert for users, system integrations, and operational excellence.
• Ensure IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection remain robust and future-ready.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external technology partners to deliver seamless digital experiences.

Profile

• 5+ years of experience in IT systems, applications, or project management.
• Strong ERP expertise; SAP experience is a major plus.
• Knowledge of e-commerce platforms (Shopify is a bonus).
• Broad understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud services, and user support.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French is an asset.
